tasks.name: זוגות לחלוקה
tasks.note: Returns how many pairs are needed to hold a items, that is a halved and rounded up.

tasks.name: בין 4 ל-11
tasks.note: Flags 15 when a is from 4 to 11, else 0.

tasks.name: האי-זוגי שמתחת
tasks.note: Returns the largest odd number not above a, or 0 when a is 0.

tasks.name: חצי אם זוגי
tasks.note: Halves a when it is even, otherwise leaves it.

tasks.name: כמה שלמים ביניהם
tasks.note: Counts the whole numbers strictly between the two inputs.

tasks.name: שלושה שונים
tasks.note: Flags 15 when all three inputs are different, else 0.

tasks.name: כפול ועוד אחד
tasks.note: Returns twice a plus one, modulo 16.

tasks.name: שער פתוח
tasks.note: Returns a when b is 8 or more, otherwise 0.

tasks.name: משלים לעשר
tasks.note: Returns how much is missing from a to reach 10, or 0 when a is 10 or more.

tasks.name: חד-ספרתי
tasks.note: Flags 15 when a has a single decimal digit, else 0.

tasks.name: ימים מעבר ל-28
tasks.note: For month number a (1 to 12, non-leap year) returns how many days the month has beyond 28; 0 for other values.

tasks.name: עיגול מטה לחמש
tasks.note: Rounds a down to a multiple of 5.

tasks.name: מס מדורג
tasks.note: Bracketed tax: nothing up to 5, one per unit from 6 to 10, two per unit above 10, capped at 15.

tasks.name: ביטים באו
tasks.note: Counts the bits set in a or in b.

tasks.name: הספרה האמצעית בבסיס 3
tasks.note: Returns the second-lowest digit of a written in base 3.

tasks.name: מרחק מטווח
tasks.note: Returns how far the first input lies outside the range from the second to the third input, 0 when inside.

tasks.name: חלוקה בחזקת שתיים
tasks.note: Shifts a right by the low two bits of b.

tasks.name: מחיר חניה
tasks.note: Parking fee for a hours: the first hour is free, then 3 per hour, capped at 15.

tasks.name: סכום ספרות של הסכום
tasks.note: Adds the inputs and returns the sum of the decimal digits of the result.

tasks.name: ציון באותיות
tasks.note: Maps a score to a grade from 0 to 4 with thresholds 4, 7, 10 and 13.

tasks.name: אמצע הטווח
tasks.note: Returns the average of the largest and smallest of three inputs, rounded down.

tasks.name: שורש עליון
tasks.src: a=>{ let k=0; while(k*k<a) k++; return k; }
tasks.note: Returns the square root of a rounded up.

tasks.name: גורם ראשוני קטן
tasks.src: a=>{ if(a<2) return 0; let d=2; while(a%d) d++; return d; }
tasks.note: Returns the smallest prime factor of a, or 0 for 0 and 1.

tasks.name: שני הקטנים יחד
tasks.note: Adds the two smallest of three inputs, capped at 15.

tasks.name: פונקציית אוילר
tasks.src: a=>{ let c=0; for(let x=1;x<=a;x++){ let g=a, h=x; while(h){ const t=g%h; g=h; h=t; } if(g===1) c++; } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the numbers from 1 to a that share no common factor with a.

tasks.name: השורד במעגל
tasks.src: (n,k)=>{ let j=0; for(let i=2;i<=n;i++) j=(j+k+1)%i; return j; }
tasks.note: With n people in a circle and every (k+1)-th removed, returns the 0-based position of the survivor.

tasks.name: הבא עם אותם ביטים
tasks.src: a=>{ const pc=x=>(x&1)+(x>>1&1)+(x>>2&1)+(x>>3&1); for(let x=a+1;x<16;x++) if(pc(x)===pc(a)) return x; return a; }
tasks.note: Returns the next larger number with the same count of set bits, or a itself if there is none.

tasks.name: ניחושים בחיפוש בינארי
tasks.src: t=>{ let lo=0, hi=15, n=0; for(;;){ const m=(lo+hi)>>1; n++; if(m===t) return n; if(m<t) lo=m+1; else hi=m-1; } }
tasks.note: Counts the guesses a binary search over 0..15 (guessing the lower middle) needs to hit t.

tasks.name: הופכי בשבע-עשרה
tasks.src: a=>{ for(let x=1;x<17;x++) if(a*x%17===1) return x; return 0; }
tasks.note: Returns the inverse of a modulo 17, or 0 for zero.

tasks.name: הראשוני הבא
tasks.src: a=>{ for(let n=a+1;n<16;n++){ let p=n>1; for(let d=2;d*d<=n;d++) if(n%d===0) p=false; if(p) return n; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Returns the smallest prime larger than a, or 0 when it would be above 15.

tasks.name: צעדי חיסור
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ let n=0; while(a&&b&&a!==b){ if(a>b) a-=b; else b-=a; n++; } return Math.min(15,n); }
tasks.note: Counts how many times the smaller number is subtracted from the larger until they are equal (or one is zero), capped at 15.

tasks.name: מרחק פרש מהפינה
tasks.note: Reads a as a square of a 4x4 board (row a>>2, column a&3) and returns the fewest knight moves from the corner square 0.

tasks.name: מהלכים מנצחים בנים
tasks.note: In Nim with piles a, b, c counts the piles from which a winning move can be made.

tasks.name: חלוקות לחלקים שונים
tasks.src: a=>{ const q=Array(a+1).fill(0); q[0]=1; for(let k=1;k<=a;k++) for(let s=a;s>=k;s--) q[s]+=q[s-k]; return Math.min(15,q[a]); }
tasks.note: Counts the ways to write a as a sum of distinct positive whole numbers, capped at 15.
